question: Does the E97 planned independent-family data expansion improve the fixed joint relic/card readout under the now repaired E121 engine?

small.selection: E87 fit family IDs, with all outcomes regenerated under E121.

expanded.selection: The same1536 plus all3072 E97 additional fit family IDs; no success selection.

representation: Inherited frozen parent192-dimensional public-state/candidate embeddings; two learned linear readouts plus fit-only option biases. Centered features and RMS scales fitted only on each arms own fit families, parent score bias1, unknown whole offers use parent. No seed or future state features.
objective: Inherited exact expected terminal binary Heart outcome over all assigned fit families and complete two-decision trees plus fixedL2; no invented preference for equal outcomes, no success-only imitation, no layer reward.
selection: Train both final checkpoints before common heldout scoring, fixed1000 steps and L2.001, no CV, checkpoint or hyperparameter sweep. Each arm vs parent must net>=20 wins and paired exactp<.05 across common1024. Claim a data-scale gain only if expanded vs small independently meets net>=20 and pairedp<.05. The pairwise development screens are not independent acceptance.
downstream: Heldout-qualified arms require all 512 natural simulator development games, net gain >=10 and paired p<.05, zero faults, full terminal/RNG/NN/timing audits, correct first-change scope and all winning replans. Select more wins, fewer lost parent wins, then small. No original-game prerequisite.
implementation_change: Keep both fit recipes and all family roles. Apply the user-requested simulator-only evidence boundary.
dependency: Complete E122 simulator sources and E127 complete audited joint labels. No original-game requirement or partial-data fit.
limits: A test of the unexecuted data-scale hypothesis on narrow coupled decisions. It is not a full-policy ceiling or the50percent goal. Failed E89/E95/E96 results stay recorded. Final acceptance requires a separately frozen candidate and1024 truly unseen families.
